exports.name: ToggleDirective
exports.summary:
Shows/hides the host element with an animated height transition, driven by the
`duiToggle` boolean input (`true` hides, `false` shows).
exports.summaryZh:
通过带高度过渡动画的方式显示/隐藏宿主元素，由 `duiToggle` 布尔输入驱动
（`true` 隐藏，`false` 显示）。

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration (ms) of the show/hide height animation.
inputs.descriptionZh: 显示/隐藏高度动画的持续时间（毫秒）。

inputs.name: state
inputs.description:
duiToggle: boolean
Toggles element, hides if its 'true', shows if its 'false'.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `state` 的设置器，用于更新状态。

methods.name: hide
methods.description:
Hides element: sets "display:[default]" so animation is shown,
starts animation and adds "display:'none'" style at the end.

methods.name: show
methods.description:
Shows element: sets "display:[default]" so animation is shown,
starts animation and adds "overflow:[default]" style again at the end.
